concept: IAM: cross-account role with ExternalId against confused deputy
tests: Knowing the pattern for third-party (SaaS) access to an account: cross-account role + ExternalId condition.
expected: A cross-account IAM role with a trust policy for the provider's account and a mandatory sts:ExternalId condition in the trust policy. Triggers: "third party / SaaS", "on your behalf", "confused deputy".
why_not: An IAM user with handed-over access keys means long-lived, leakable credentials; public resources remove access control entirely.
